annotations.title: Make a short in a ready format

description: Plan a short-form video (Reel / TikTok / Short) in one of Hermoso's ready FORMATS: a written structure (beats, camera, length, aspect) plus the layers it lays on the finished video (its caption look, a closing "Comment KEYWORD" ask, cards). Call with no `preset` to list every format, which are ready and which are coming (free). With a preset: the person in it is this brand's own (pass `creator` to render_ad to star a saved creator), the words are about `topic`, the length is the format's own unless durationSeconds is given, and an optional reference `url` (a TikTok / Reel / Facebook / X post or a direct file) is watched and its length matched up to 120s. Renders nothing: costs the plan only (about 10-20 credits, more with a reference link). Then render_ad(creative) makes the video in the format's aspect, and finish_short(video, creative) lays the format's captions and close. A format whose layers are not built yet is refused before anything is charged.

closeStyle.description: the look of the Comment card: handwritten, red (condensed caps), pill (dark on white), yellow (bold caps)

durationSeconds.description: override the length in seconds (5-180); omit for the format's own length

keyword.description: the one word viewers comment to get something (e.g. GUIDE). Adds or replaces the closing "Comment KEYWORD" ask

language.description: language for the script, default English

noClose.description: true = no Comment close, even on a format that has one

offer.description: what a commenter is sent, e.g. "the PDF" (said after the keyword)

preset.description: the format id or name (omit to list them all)

topic.description: what the short is about, one sentence in the user's words

url.description: optional reference video to follow: a TikTok / Instagram Reel / Facebook / X link or a direct https file (not YouTube); a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

name: make_short
title: Make a short in a ready format
